hooks.command:
bash -c '
CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null)
STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null)
ALL=$(printf "%s\n%s" "$CHANGED" "$STAGED" | sort -u | grep -v "^$")

if [ -z "$ALL" ]; then exit 0; fi

ISSUES=""
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  HITS=$(grep -n "TODO\|FIXME\|HACK\|XXX\|not yet implemented\|throw NotImplementedError" "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$HITS" ] && ISSUES="${ISSUES}\n${f}:\n${HITS}"
done <<< "$ALL"

if [ -n "$ISSUES" ]; then
  printf "Post-task stop-hook found loose ends in changed files.\n\nFiles with TODOs / stubs:\n%s\n\nPlease address each item above, or explicitly confirm it is intentional and out of scope for this task. Also confirm: did the tests you claimed to run actually pass? Show evidence or re-run them now." "$ISSUES"
  exit 2
fi

printf "Stop-hook: no TODOs or stubs found in changed files. Still — did any tests you claimed to run actually pass? If you ran no tests, say so plainly."
exit 2
'
